The Suryagadhi market and Nilkantha temple are cut off from the rest of the network, since their only remaining road is the one to each other and the Kalika-Nilkantha road is impassable. Those two must be deferred. The other seven people are reached through Kalika temple, so the car makes two trips: 3 elderly plus the injured person first, then the last 3 elderly.

<plan>
drive car1 jwalamukhi-shelter gajuri-school
drive car1 gajuri-school kalika-temple
load car1 elderly 3
drive car1 kalika-temple syaphru-care-home
load car1 injured 1
drive car1 syaphru-care-home kalika-temple
drive car1 kalika-temple gajuri-school
drive car1 gajuri-school jwalamukhi-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
unload car1 injured 1
drive car1 jwalamukhi-shelter gajuri-school
drive car1 gajuri-school kalika-temple
load car1 elderly 3
drive car1 kalika-temple gajuri-school
drive car1 gajuri-school jwalamukhi-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
defer nilkantha-temple elderly 1
defer suryagadhi-market adult 1
</plan>
